review_description: This experience I have had has been really surprising to me as the management did all the work getting me connected. The electrical inspector said it was the best job he has seen with the way my setup was, is. Will I use this company again.You bet.
Quiet straight forward and easy to communicate.Custom service good
Very competitive quote and professional service. Install was also very good and smooth. For me it was complex but both sales men and installer made it so simple and smooth for me to understand

The sales process was explained thoroughly before proceeding, and the install was done well before the promised time frame.Honestly - These boys organised everything from start to finish and even setup the apps for us and still call us to follow up to make sure we are happy with it all including the savings we are gaining out of this solar install.HIGHLY RECOMMEND !
